anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

bible_refs.note: From Pharaoh on the throne to the maidservant at the mill.
The same range of the firstborn struck.
He raises the poor from the dunghill and seats them with princes.
LXX 112:7-8: from the dunghill to a throne.

pass_a_gloss: For they go over through the naming of this mystery, having partaken of it, having procured for themselves salvation, the not being destroyed-together with the firstborn of the Egyptians from Pharaoh who sits upon his throne, even to a maidservant the one beside the mill, that is of those in a lifting-up of wealth and tyranny being in ignorance and not having recognized the one raising kings from a dunghill and seating them upon royal thrones.
pass_b_english: For they go over through the name of this mystery, having partaken of it, having procured for themselves salvation: not to be destroyed together with the firstborn of the Egyptians from Pharaoh, who sits on his throne, even to the maidservant at the mill — that is, of those who are in a lifting-up of wealth and tyranny, in ignorance, and have not recognized the one who raises kings from a dunghill and seats them on royal thrones.
source_text: Ὑπερβαίνουσιν γὰρ διὰ τῆς ὀνομασίας τοῦ μυστηρίου τούτου μετειληφότες αὐτοῦ, σωτηρίαν ἑαυτοῖς πορισάμενοι τὸ μὴ συνεξολεθρευθῆναι τοῖς πρωτοτόκοις τῶν Αἰγυπτίων ἀπὸ Φαραώ, ὃς καθῆται ἐπὶ τοῦ θρόνου αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἕως παιδίσκης τῆς παρὰ τὸν μύλον, ὅ ἐστιν τῶν ἐν ἐπάρσει πλούτου καὶ τυραννίδος ὄντων ἐν ἀγνοίᾳ καὶ μὴ ἐπιγνόντων τὸν βασιλεῖς ἐγείροντα ἀπὸ κοπρίας καὶ καθιζάνοντα ἐπὶ θρόνους βασιλικούς.
